name: Octree Neighbor Search
definition: An algorithm to find the adjacent cell 'a' sharing a specific face 'f' with a given cell 'c' in a generalized octree, handling cases where the neighbor might be at a different subdivision level.
summary: Octree Neighbor Search finds adjacent cells in generalized octrees with anisotropic subdivision, differing from pathfinding methods by focusing on spatial adjacency in hierarchical structures.
